directions.name: Red Engine
directions.description: Bold, industrial, high-energy. Full-width hero with plumber image bleeding edge-to-edge, thick red banner headline. Services as icon cards on dark graphite band. Sharp edges, no rounded corners. Massive stat numbers. Sticky emergency CTA on mobile.
directions.rationale: Kyle does emergency callouts and powerflushing — this direction feels urgent, confident, and no-nonsense. The red carries from his current brand.

directions.name: Copper Pipe
directions.description: Warm and editorial. Split-screen hero with headline on cream, photo on right. Alternating cream/navy sections. Rounded cards with subtle shadows. Horizontal testimonial carousel. Serif headings for authority, copper accents reference the trade.
directions.rationale: Positions KJP as the experienced, trusted local choice. Copper references plumbing fittings. Editorial style makes reviews and credentials feel substantial.

directions.name: Blueprint
directions.description: Clean, modern, tech-forward. Typographic hero with massive headline and phone number, subtle grid-line background. Services in tight 2x3 grid with hover reveals. Pill-shaped buttons, generous padding. Trust badges as compact logo row. Electric blue with lime CTA accents.
directions.rationale: Modern tradesmen need modern sites. This direction makes KJP stand out from every other plumber in Southampton running a generic template.
